suggestions.pitch: The rebuilding 3-6 partner gets two bench veterans while I add Goedert and White, who start for me, for the playoff push.
Pollard and Pacheco are bench depth, and Goedert would be a strong starting upgrade at tight end with TE premium.
Watson is on the fringe of my lineup, and Brissett plus Mason Taylor add useful QB and TE depth from a team that accepts at 0.83.
